examples.title: Blur only the alpha channel of the selected node
examples.code:
# Add an alpha-only blur after the currently selected node.
source = nuke.selectedNode()

blur = nuke.createNode("Blur")
blur.setInput(0, source)
blur["channels"].setValue("alpha")
blur["size"].setValue(20)

examples.title: Create a horizontal motion-style blur
examples.code:
# Use the two components of size independently.
source = nuke.selectedNode()

blur = nuke.createNode("Blur")
blur.setInput(0, source)
blur["size"].setValue(30, 0)
blur["size"].setValue(0, 1)
